subject: [PATCH 6/8] selftests/mm: check MADV_COLD and MADV_PAGEOUT on partly advised THPs

2026-10-14.patch_summary: This patch adds self-tests to verify the behavior of MADV_COLD and MADV_PAGEOUT on transparent huge pages (THPs). It checks that a whole PMD-mapped THP is swapped intact, that pages outside the range stay resident after paging out a base page or half of a PMD- or PTE-mapped THP, and that MADV_COLD on half of either THP preserves its contents. The tests also verify that a partly advised THP is split before reclaim, or skipped, to prevent corruption. The patch includes new functions for reserving and mapping aligned memory ranges.
